Mac Mouse Fix **2.2.6** adds support for **macOS 27 Golden Gate** and brings back support for older macOS versions.

- Now supporting **macOS 27 Golden Gate** - The UI has been updated and the 'Mission Control & Spaces' gesture works again.
- Supporting **macOS 10.11 El Capitan** and **macOS 10.12 Sierra** again, which had last been supported in MMF 2.2.0. Apple's developer tools don't officially support this but it still seems to work. I haven't had a chance to test on older macOS versions, so if there are any problems, let me know.
- Updated some of the links under 'More...' and elsewhere.
- Fixed a small UI bug where the 'Scroll speed' slider would sometimes be enabled even though 'Smooth scrolling' is disabled.

---

Also see the previous release [2.2.5](https://github.com/noah-nuebling/mac-mouse-fix/releases/tag/2.2.5)
